title: Shakespeare basics
examples: What is the difference between a comedy and a tragedy?
Where did Shakespeare perform his plays?
Can you name a famous play by Shakespeare?

explain.say: Shakespeare wrote many famous plays for us to read.

items: William Shakespeare was a famous writer.
He wrote plays for the stage.
His works are still popular today.

explain.say: The Globe was a famous theatre where plays were shown.
Shakespeare wrote plays that were comedies or tragedies.
A comedy usually ends with marriage and celebration.
A tragedy usually involves a character's downfall or death.
A real life example is watching a play today.

faq.q: What is the difference between a comedy and a tragedy?
faq.a: A comedy usually has a happy ending, often involving romance. A tragedy usually has a sad ending, often involving death or great loss.
asks: What makes a play a tragedy?

faq.q: Where did Shakespeare first perform his plays?
faq.a: Shakespeare often performed at the Globe Theatre in London. This was a very popular place for plays.

faq.q: Are all Shakespeare's plays comedies or tragedies?
faq.a: No, Shakespeare wrote many different types of plays. He wrote comedies, tragedies, and histories.
asks: Did he write only one type?
What other types of plays did he write?

faq.q: What is the best way to learn about Shakespeare?
faq.a: Reading summaries and watching performances helps a lot. You can also read about the Globe Theatre.
asks: What should I do to learn more?

faq.q: Does the genre change a play's meaning?
faq.a: Yes, the genre helps us understand what to expect. A comedy suggests fun, while a tragedy suggests serious themes.
asks: Does the ending tell the genre?

facts: Shakespeare wrote plays in the English language.
The Globe Theatre was a famous open-air theatre.
Comedies typically end happily for the main characters.
Tragedies often explore themes of fate and downfall.

quiz.say: A play where the main character suffers a great downfall is most likely a:
quiz.why: A downfall of a main character is the key feature of a tragedy.

wrong.1: Comedies are meant to have joyful or lighthearted resolutions.
wrong.2: History plays focus on real historical events, not just genre.
wrong.3: Farces are usually silly and do not carry the weight of a downfall.

quiz.say: If a play ends with the main characters getting married, it is probably a:
quiz.why: Marriage and celebration are common markers of a comedic ending.

wrong.0: Drama is too general; comedy points to the specific happy outcome.
wrong.2: Tragedies usually end with loss, not union.
wrong.3: History plays might end with peace, but the focus is on events.

quiz.say: When thinking about Shakespeare's works, the Globe Theatre was the main place for:
quiz.why: The Globe Theatre was the physical location where his plays were staged for audiences.

wrong.0: While he wrote there, the theatre was for the performance itself.
wrong.1: The primary function of the Globe was to host live shows.
wrong.2: The theatre was used for the final, public performances.
